observations: Photo 0: Two vintage sewing machine tables sit outdoors on cracked concrete; the left has a blue painted top with a rectangular cutout, the right has a wood-grain top with a rectangular cutout, both on black cast iron treadle stands.
Photo 1: The same two tables are shown from a similar angle with watermarks overlaid across the image.
Photo 2: A close-up of the blue table top reveals a rectangular machine recess, a measurement scale along the front edge, and the treadle base underneath.
Photo 3: A close-up of the wood-grain table top shows the machine recess and the large treadle wheel on the right; a green motor is partially visible at the left edge.
not_shown: Whether a sewing machine head is included with either table
Working condition of the treadle mechanisms and foot pedals
Condition of the table tops beyond visible wear such as scratches, water damage, or veneer lifting
Whether the green motor seen at the edge of photo 3 is included and functional
Stability or wobbliness of the stands
